name: Responsive Intelligence
runtime_tests: Generate a 6-section automotive homepage and inspect desktop/tablet/mobile.
Check 3-4 column card Sparks collapse without horizontal overflow.
Check hero H1 and CTA labels do not clip on mobile.
Check slider/gallery/video media stays inside viewport and remains usable on touch.
Check section spacing reduces from desktop to tablet/mobile.
Publish and spot-check responsive behavior before the deeper Batch 8 parity audit.
